text:
maya: Quick heads-up  spotted a docs mismatch in the API ref for PATCH /models/{model_id}/settings. The OpenAPI schema and the live contract use a nested `safety` object with `blocklist`, but the example payload in the docs still shows `safety_blocklist` at top-level. PR referenced: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 (example contains flat key).

jonathan: Thanks. Which is canonical here—OpenAPI schema or the example?

lee: The runtime expects `safety.blocklist` (we migrated the service in Q3). We left a compat shim accepting flat keys, but docs should match the live contract (nested). :eyes: 

sam: Action items: (1) update the example JSON in the API page, (2) update the SDK snippets (Go/JS) in the docs that show constructing the request, and (3) add a short migration note for older clients showing a jq/curl transform.

maya: I can update the example JSON + migration note. I'll run the docs build locally; CI is failing with the linter currently.

doc-builder-bot: build failed: docs/api/models.yaml: schema-example-mismatch (error code 1004). CI log: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/1234

jonathan: Current Go snippet in the docs shows: 
```go
req := &UpdateModelSettings{
  SafetyBlocklist: []string{"bad","worse"},
}
client.UpdateModel(ctx, modelID, req)
```
We should change that to: 
```go
req := &UpdateModelSettings{
  Safety: &SafetySettings{
    Blocklist: []string{"bad","worse"},
  },
}
client.UpdateModel(ctx, modelID, req)
```
I'll open a follow-up PR to update the SDK snippets in the docs folder.

lee: For JS snippet swap `safety_blocklist` -> `safety: { blocklist: [...] }`. Also audit curl examples.

sam: Suggested migration blurb: "Deprecated: top-level `safety_blocklist`. As of 2024-09-01 send `safety: { blocklist: [...] }`. A compatibility shim will accept the old keys for ~30 days; migrate soon." Add an example transform (jq + curl).

maya: Proposed curl transform for the migration guide: 
```bash
# old payload: {"safety_blocklist": ["x"]}
# new payload: {"safety": {"blocklist": ["x"]}}
cat old.json | jq '{safety: {blocklist: .safety_blocklist}}' | curl -X PATCH -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @- https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/$ID/settings
```

doc-builder-bot: note: once examples + schema align the linter error should clear. Also update openapi/examples/models/update-settings.json if present.

jonathan: Owners: @maya update API example + migration note (link PR), @jonathan update docs snippets (PR), @lee confirm shim removal timeline and provide concrete date for migration note, @sam add changelog entry for deprecation. I'll add docs-review label.

maya: Pushing my PR today, will link back here. Thanks! :thumbsup:
